prompt: Navy plants a garden behind the school
title: Navy's School Garden
irony: Navy gives every seed away to grow his own garden, so the garden only grows when the friends he gave to plant it with him.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning light fills the big house yard where Navy holds seed packets beside bare dirt.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Navy shows Green his school garden map and hands his best seeds to Black who asks.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black bets Navy his candy beans grow ten feet by Friday, leaving Navy three tiny seeds.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The kids kneel by the dirt patch, patting soil and chanting about their school garden.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Navy plants seeds upside down in dry dirt while Green reads facts but fears the worms.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Black dumps a whole bucket to win the bet and floods the rows into thick mud soup.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The muddy kids stare at the puddles and sing the school garden chant again together.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gray kneels in the mud with old charts and sees planning never plants a single seed.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gray drops the charts in the mud and starts planting, while Navy hands Gray more seeds.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The friends replant the rows together and learn giving seeds brings growers back.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Sprouts dot the dirt rows where friends water together in the changed school garden.
